verifiedBy: SOURCED — rate (₹51.50/SCM) taken directly from MNGL's own official rate card (PMC + PCMC area, effective midnight 16 Jun 2026). MNGL applies a 4-SCM-per-cycle minimum-consumption rule (billed as if you used 4 SCM even if actual usage is lower), which this calculator does NOT model — real bills for very low usage (under 4 SCM/cycle) will be higher than this estimate. No separate flat fixed/meter charge beyond that minimum-consumption rule was found on the official rate card; one-time registration (₹500), late-payment (₹100) and reconnection (₹1,500) charges are excluded since they aren't part of a regular bill.
